title: When You Say Nothing at All

cues.en: It's amazing how you can speak right to my heart
cues.zh: 多麼不可思議，你的話語能直抵我心深處
cues.text: It's amazing how you can speak right to my heart

cues.en: Without saying a word, you can light up the dark
cues.zh: 不用說一句話，你可以點亮黑暗
cues.text: Without saying a word, you can light up the dark

cues.en: Try as I may, I can never explain
cues.zh: 盡我所能，我無法解釋
cues.text: Try as I may, I can never explain

cues.en: What I hear when you don't say a thing
cues.zh: 當你什麼都不說時，我所聽到的
cues.text: What I hear when you don't say a thing

cues.en: The smile on your face lets me know that you need me
cues.zh: 你臉上的笑容讓我知道你需要我
cues.text: The smile on your face lets me know that you need me

cues.en: There's a truth in your eyes saying you'll never leave me
cues.zh: 你眼中有句話說你永遠不會離開我
cues.text: There's a truth in your eyes saying you'll never leave me

cues.en: The touch of your hand says you'll catch me wherever I fall
cues.zh: 你的手說無論我跌到哪裡你都會抓住我
cues.text: The touch of your hand says you'll catch me wherever I fall

cues.en: You say it best, when you say nothing at all
cues.zh: （你說得最好，當你什麼都不說的時候）
cues.text: You say it best, when you say nothing at all

cues.en: All day long, I can hear people talking out loud (ooh)
cues.zh: 一整天，我都能聽到人們大聲說話（哦）
cues.text: All day long, I can hear people talking out loud (ooh)

cues.en: But when you hold me near (you hold me near) you drown out the crowd (out the crowd)
cues.zh: 但是當你把我抱在身邊（你把我抱在身邊）時，你會淹沒人群（淹沒人群）

cues.en: Try as they may, they can never define
cues.zh: 盡可能地嘗試，他們永遠無法定義

cues.en: What's being said between your heart and mine
